claims: As of March 2026, Timothée Chalamet has received four career Oscar nominations.
Timothée Chalamet received a Best Actor in a Leading Role nomination for Marty Supreme in 2026.
Timothée Chalamet received a Best Picture nomination as a producer for Marty Supreme in 2026.
Timothée Chalamet received a Best Actor in a Leading Role nomination for A Complete Unknown in 2025.
Timothée Chalamet received a Best Actor in a Leading Role nomination for Call Me by Your Name in 2018.
Timothée Chalamet is the youngest male actor to earn three Best Actor nominations since Marlon Brando.
Timothée Chalamet became the youngest male actor to earn three Best Actor nominations in Academy history at 30 years old.
Timothée Chalamet became one of the youngest to earn both a Best Actor and Best Picture nomination in the same year with Marty Supreme
